name: Tickerbar
author: mryll
description: Multi-market price ticker (crypto, stocks, indices, commodities, forex, rates) in the Omarchy bar.

barWidget.description: Click: market table. Middle click: refresh.

schema.label: Refresh interval (seconds)
schema.description: How often to re-run the CLI. Quotes are cached, and a market that is closed does not move — the widget backs off on its own.

schema.label: Config file (empty = ~/.config/tickerbar/config.toml)
schema.description: Absolute path to a TOML file listing the assets to track. Leave empty to use ~/.config/tickerbar/config.toml.

schema.label: Watchlist average on the bar
schema.description: Applies to the BAR only; the panel shows the average by default. follow = honor the config's summary_format; show forces it on the bar; hide removes it from both.

schema.label: Colors
schema.description: Monochrome rendering uses foreground tones only — severity stays readable through the numbers and glyphs. none: no color anywhere. bar-only: colored bar face, plain panel. panel-only: the reverse.
